title: ID0415427-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002549] DC2_CableTempSensor (C1)
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
The outlet DC2 on charger ugTWsO shows the error flag "DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101".
Please check from your side.
Open Ticket:
No
Root cause:
Solution:
Software Version: v6.0.3-0-g215cb74+APN (PRODUCTION)
OCPP Backend Connection: Yes
WO 4338

additional_info.subject: Action carried
additional_info.body:
The charger has been rebooted, but the CableTempSensor error has reoccurred.
We Checked the temperature via SSH, and it appears to be abnormal.
DC2
DC1

additional_info.subject: Checked the logs from the last 4 weeks, and the issue has been persistent during that time as well
Note to L3
additional_info.body:
Suspected Root Cause:
Seems issue with temperature sensor or its connections
Problem Description:
DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101
Action Performed (L2):
I rebooted the charger, but the issue reoccurs even after the reboot. I checked the key
‘DC2_CableTempSensor’
on AWS for the last 4 months and noticed that the issue has been recurring for the past 4 months as well.
I also checked the temperature readings of
DC1
and
DC2
. DC1 is showing normal readings, but
DC2
is displaying a temperature of
-273°C
(please refer to the note below).
Charger SW Version:
v6.0.3
Reason for Handover (L3):
As per the instructions in the Field Issue Tracker Excel sheet
Fault history:
NA
Action Required by HQ:
Further investigation
